name: join-duplicate-build-keys
description: Compare duplicate right-side build keys with unique fact-to-dimension builds

queries.name: duplicate-right-build
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, e.event_id FROM accounts a JOIN events e ON a.user_id = e.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: unique-right-build
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: duplicate-left-outer
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, e.event_id FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN events e ON a.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.event_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
